## Appendix A: The Complete 2023–2027 Pool (sample)

Every question below is quoted verbatim from the 2023–2027 General pool, with the correct answer marked and a one-line why pointing at the chapter that teaches it.

> **G1A01** On which bands may a General class licensee transmit phone emissions?
> A. No amateur bands
> B. All amateur bands, with some segments reserved for higher license classes
> C. The 2 meter band only
> D. The 70 centimeter band only
> **Answer: B** — Generals get every band, but some segments stay Extra-only (chapter 1).

> **G1A03** What is the maximum transmitting power a General class licensee may use on the 60 meter band?
> A. 50 watts PEP
> B. 100 watts PEP effective radiated power relative to a dipole
> C. 200 watts PEP
> D. 1500 watts PEP
> **Answer: B** — the 60 meter limit is 100 watts ERP relative to a dipole (chapter 1).
